title.sw: Mambo ambayo LC1 wako anaweza kushughulikia

answer.en: Your LC1 chairperson can handle: small civil debts below 1,000,000 UGX, boundary disputes on customary land, family disagreements under customary law, and enforcing village by-laws. Go to your village LC1 office first. It is free and fast.
answer.lg: Omukulembeze wa LC1 asobola okukola bino: amabanja amatono agali wansi wa UGX 1,000,000, enjawulo ku nsalo z'ettaka ery'obutonde, enkaayana z'amaka ng'obulawuzi bw'obutonde, n'okulaba ng'amateeka g'ekyalo gakwatibwa. Sooka ogende ku offiisi ya LC1 mu kyalo kyo. Kwa bwereere era kyangu.
answer.sw: Mwenyekiti wako wa LC1 anaweza kushughulikia: madeni madogo chini ya UGX 1,000,000, migogoro ya mipaka ya ardhi ya kimila, tofauti za kifamilia chini ya sheria za kimila, na kutekeleza sheria ndogo za kijiji. Anza kwa kwenda ofisi ya LC1 kijijini kwako. Ni bure na ni haraka.

legal_citation: Local Governments Act Cap 138; Local Council Courts Act

illegal_practices.en: LC1 must not charge you to hear your case. Anyone demanding payment to open a case file is acting illegally. Report them to LC2.
illegal_practices.lg: LC1 teekeddwa kukusasuza ssente okuwulira omusango gwo. Omuntu yenna akusaba ssente okuggulawo fayiro akola ekitali mu mateeka. Mumanyise ku LC2.
illegal_practices.sw: LC1 haipaswi kukutoza pesa kusikiliza kesi yako. Mtu yeyote anayedai malipo kufungua jalada anafanya kinyume cha sheria. Mrripoti kwa LC2.

en: Go to your village LC1 office with your ID
Explain the matter and bring any papers or witnesses
Get the written decision and keep a copy
lg: Genda ku offiisi ya LC1 mu kyalo kyo ng'olina ID yo
Nyonyola ensonga era oleete ebbaluwa zonna oba abajulizi
Funa ensalawo mu buwandiike era okwateko koppi
sw: Nenda ofisi ya LC1 kijijini kwako na kitambulisho chako
Eleza jambo na ulete nyaraka zozote au mashahidi
Pata uamuzi ulioandikwa na uhifadhi nakala

question.en: Did you know? Your LC1 can settle small debts below 1M UGX for free.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? LC1 yo esobola okumala amabanja amatono agali wansi wa UGX 1,000,000 kwa bwereere.
question.sw: Ulijua? LC1 wako anaweza kumaliza madeni madogo chini ya UGX 1,000,000 bure.

answer.en: Yes. Small civil debts, customary boundary disputes and village by-laws start at LC1. No fee.
answer.lg: Yee. Amabanja amatono, enjawulo z'ensalo ez'obutonde n'amateeka g'ekyalo bitandikira ku LC1. Tewali ssente.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Madeni madogo, migogoro ya mipaka ya kimila na sheria za kijiji huanzia LC1. Hakuna malipo.

title.sw: Mambo ambayo LC1 wako HAWEZI kushughulikia

answer.en: Your LC1 CANNOT handle: criminal cases (theft, assault, defilement), disputes over mailo or registered/titled land, anything involving weapons, immigration matters, or collecting taxes. For these, go to the Police, the District Land Board, or the right office. An LC1 that touches these cases is acting outside the law.
answer.lg: LC1 yo TEYINZA kukola bino: emisango gy'obubbi (okubba, okukuba, okusobya ku baana), enjawulo ku ttaka lya mailo oba eririna title, ekintu kyonna ekirimu emmundu, ensonga z'abagenyi, oba okusolooza omusolo. Ebyo bigende ku Poliisi, ku District Land Board, oba ku offiisi entuufu. LC1 ekwata ku ebyo ekola ekitali mu mateeka.
answer.sw: LC1 wako HAWEZI kushughulikia: kesi za jinai (wizi, kushambuliwa, ubakaji wa watoto), migogoro ya ardhi ya mailo au yenye hati, jambo lolote linalohusisha silaha, mambo ya uhamiaji, au kukusanya kodi. Kwa hayo, nenda kwa Polisi, Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya, au ofisi husika. LC1 inayoshika hayo inafanya kinyume cha sheria.

legal_citation: Local Governments Act Cap 138; Penal Code Act
correct_authority: Police / District Land Board / relevant office (depends on matter)

illegal_practices.en: If an LC1 demands money to handle a criminal case or a titled-land dispute, refuse and report to Police or LC3. That is abuse of office.
illegal_practices.lg: LC1 bw'ekusaba ssente okukwata omusango gw'obubbi oba enjawulo y'ettaka eririna title, gaana era otegeeze Poliisi oba LC3. Okwo kwe kutyoboola offiisi.
illegal_practices.sw: LC1 ikikudai pesa kushughulikia kesi ya jinai au mgogoro wa ardhi yenye hati, kataa na uripoti kwa Polisi au LC3. Huko ni matumizi mabaya ya ofisi.

en: For crime: go straight to the nearest Police station
For mailo/titled land: go to the District Land Board
For taxes: go to URA or your municipal revenue office
lg: Ku musango gw'obubbi: genda butereevu ku Poliisi erisinga okumpi
Ku mailo/ettaka eririna title: genda ku District Land Board
Ku musolo: genda ku URA oba ku offiisi y'omusolo mu kitundu kyo
sw: Kwa jinai: nenda moja kwa moja kituo cha Polisi kilicho karibu
Kwa mailo/ardhi yenye hati: nenda Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya
Kwa kodi: nenda URA au ofisi ya mapato ya manispaa yako

question.en: Did you know? LC1 cannot handle criminal cases or titled-land disputes.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? LC1 teyinza kukwata misango gy'obubbi oba enjawulo z'ettaka eririna title.
question.sw: Ulijua? LC1 haiwezi kushughulikia kesi za jinai au migogoro ya ardhi yenye hati.

answer.en: True. Crime goes to Police. Mailo and titled land goes to the District Land Board.
answer.lg: Mazima. Obubbi bugenda ku Poliisi. Mailo n'ettaka eririna title bigenda ku District Land Board.
answer.sw: Kweli. Jinai huenda kwa Polisi. Mailo na ardhi yenye hati huenda Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya.

title.sw: Mambo ambayo LC2 wako anaweza kushughulikia

answer.en: Your LC2 (parish level) can handle: appeals from LC1 decisions, larger civil matters, parish and sub-county planning, and coordinating work between villages. If you are not happy with an LC1 decision, appeal to LC2 within 30 days.
answer.lg: LC2 yo (ku mutendera gw'omuluka) esobola okukola bino: okuwulira okujulira ku nsalawo za LC1, emisango emikulu egy'obutonde, enteekateeka z'omuluka ne ggombolola, n'okugatta emirimu gy'ebyalo. Bw'oba tolina matizigavu ku nsalawo ya LC1, julira ku LC2 mu nnaku 30.
answer.sw: LC2 wako (ngazi ya parishi) anaweza kushughulikia: rufaa dhidi ya maamuzi ya LC1, mashauri makubwa ya kimila, mipango ya parishi na tarafa, na kuratibu kazi kati ya vijiji. Usiporidhika na uamuzi wa LC1, kata rufaa kwa LC2 ndani ya siku 30.

illegal_practices.en: LC2 must not hear a case before LC1 has decided it, and must not charge appeal fees. Report fee demands to LC3.
illegal_practices.lg: LC2 teekeddwa kuwulira musango nga LC1 tennagusalawaza, era teekeddwa kusasuza ssente z'okujulira. Abasaba ssente bategeeze ku LC3.
illegal_practices.sw: LC2 haipaswi kusikiliza shauri kabla LC1 haijaamua, wala kutoza ada za rufaa. Ripoti wanaodai pesa kwa LC3.

en: Get the written LC1 decision first
Write a short appeal letter to the LC2 chairperson
Attend the LC2 hearing with your witnesses
lg: Soooka ofune ensalawo ya LC1 mu buwandiike
Wandiika ebbaluwa ennyimpi ey'okujulira eri omukulembeze wa LC2
Genda mu kuwulira kwa LC2 ng'olina abajulizi bo
sw: Anza kupata uamuzi ulioandikwa wa LC1
Andika barua fupi ya rufaa kwa mwenyekiti wa LC2
Hudhuria usikilizaji wa LC2 na mashahidi wako

question.en: Did you know? Unhappy with an LC1 decision? Appeal to LC2 within 30 days.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Bw'oba tolina matizigavu ku LC1, julira ku LC2 mu nnaku 30.
question.sw: Ulijua? Hauridhiki na uamuzi wa LC1? Kata rufaa kwa LC2 ndani ya siku 30.

answer.en: Yes. Carry the written LC1 decision and appeal in writing. It is free.
answer.lg: Yee. Twala ensalawo ya LC1 mu buwandiike era ojulire mu buwandiike. Kwa bwereere.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Beba uamuzi ulioandikwa wa LC1 na ukate rufaa kwa maandishi. Ni bure.

title.sw: Mambo ambayo LC2 wako HAWEZI kushughulikia

answer.en: Your LC2 CANNOT handle: criminal cases, disputes over registered or titled land, or national policy matters. LC2 also cannot overturn a court judgment. Take crime to Police, titled land to the District Land Board, and policy complaints to your MP or councillor.
answer.lg: LC2 yo TEYINZA kukola bino: emisango gy'obubbi, enjawulo ku ttaka eririna title, oba ensonga za mateeka ga gwanga. LC2 era teyinza kukyusa nsalawo ya kkooti. Obubbi butwale ku Poliisi, ettaka eririna title ku District Land Board, n'ensonga za mateeka eri MP wo oba kansala wo.
answer.sw: LC2 wako HAWEZI kushughulikia: kesi za jinai, migogoro ya ardhi iliyosajiliwa au yenye hati, au mambo ya sera za kitaifa. LC2 pia haiwezi kubatilisha hukumu ya mahakama. Jinai peleka kwa Polisi, ardhi yenye hati kwa Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya, na malalamiko ya sera kwa Mbunge wako au diwani wako.

correct_authority: Police / District Land Board / MP (depends on matter)

illegal_practices.en: An LC2 that claims it can overturn a court order or grab titled land is breaking the law. Report to LC3 or Police.
illegal_practices.lg: LC2 egamba nti esobola okukyusa ekiragiro kya kkooti oba okutwala ettaka eririna title emenya mateeka. Gitegeeze ku LC3 oba ku Poliisi.
illegal_practices.sw: LC2 inayodai inaweza kubatilisha amri ya mahakama au kunyakua ardhi yenye hati inavunja sheria. Ripoti kwa LC3 au Polisi.

en: For crime: report to Police immediately
For titled land: file at the District Land Board
For policy issues: write to your MP or area councillor
lg: Ku bubbi: tegeeza ku Poliisi amangu ago
Ku ttaka eririna title: ggulawo fayiro ku District Land Board
Ku nsonga za mateeka: wandikira MP wo oba kansala wo
sw: Kwa jinai: ripoti kwa Polisi mara moja
Kwa ardhi yenye hati: fungua jalada Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya
Kwa masuala ya sera: mwandikie Mbunge wako au diwani wako

question.en: Did you know? LC2 cannot overturn a court judgment.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? LC2 teyinza kukyusa nsalawo ya kkooti.
question.sw: Ulijua? LC2 haiwezi kubatilisha hukumu ya mahakama.

answer.en: True. Only a higher court can change a court order. LC2 handles appeals from LC1 only.
answer.lg: Mazima. Kkooti esinga obukulu yokka y'esobola okukyusa ekiragiro kya kkooti. LC2 ekwata okujulira okuva ku LC1 kwokka.
answer.sw: Kweli. Mahakama ya juu pekee ndiyo inaweza kubadilisha amri ya mahakama. LC2 hushughulikia rufaa kutoka LC1 pekee.

title.sw: Mambo ambayo LC3 wako anaweza kushughulikia

answer.en: Your LC3 (division or sub-county level) can handle: division-level planning and budgets, appeals from LC2 decisions, and coordinating work between parishes. LC3 also oversees local revenue and service delivery in your division. Appeals from LC2 go to LC3.
answer.lg: LC3 yo (ku mutendera gwa divizoni oba ggombolola) esobola okukola bino: enteekateeka n'embalirira z'ekitundu, okuwulira okujulira okuva ku LC2, n'okugatta emirimu gy'emiruka. LC3 era elabirira ensimbi z'ekitundu n'okuweereza obuweereza. Okujulira okuva ku LC2 kugenda ku LC3.
answer.sw: LC3 wako (ngazi ya divisheni au tarafa) anaweza kushughulikia: mipango na bajeti za eneo, rufaa dhidi ya maamuzi ya LC2, na kuratibu kazi kati ya parishi. LC3 pia husimamia mapato ya eneo na utoaji wa huduma. Rufaa kutoka LC2 huenda kwa LC3.

illegal_practices.en: LC3 officials must not demand a cut of division funds or charge for appeal hearings. Report extortion to the District leadership or Police.
illegal_practices.lg: Abakulu ba LC3 tebakkirizibwa kusaba ekitundu ku nsimbi z'ekitundu oba okusasuza okuwulira okujulira. Abakutyoboola bategeeze ku bakulembeze ba disitulikiti oba ku Poliisi.
illegal_practices.sw: Maafisa wa LC3 hawapaswi kudai sehemu ya fedha za eneo wala kutoza usikilizaji wa rufaa. Ripoti unyang'anyi kwa uongozi wa wilaya au Polisi.

en: Get the written LC2 decision first
Write your appeal to the LC3 chairperson
Attend the LC3 tribunal hearing when called
lg: Soooka ofune ensalawo ya LC2 mu buwandiike
Wandiika okujulira kwo eri omukulembeze wa LC3
Genda mu kuwulira kwa kkooti ya LC3 bw'okoowoobwa
sw: Anza kupata uamuzi ulioandikwa wa LC2
Andika rufaa yako kwa mwenyekiti wa LC3
Hudhuria usikilizaji wa baraza la LC3 unapoitwa

question.en: Did you know? Appeals from LC2 go to LC3 at your division.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Okujulira okuva ku LC2 kugenda ku LC3 mu divizoni yo.
question.sw: Ulijua? Rufaa kutoka LC2 huenda kwa LC3 katika divisheni yako.

answer.en: Yes. Always carry the written LC2 decision when you appeal to LC3.
answer.lg: Yee. Bulijjo twala ensalawo ya LC2 mu buwandiike bw'ojulira ku LC3.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Kila wakati beba uamuzi ulioandikwa wa LC2 unapokata rufaa kwa LC3.

answer.en: In Kampala, KCCA handles: city planning, road construction and repair, waste collection, markets and trading spaces, and KCCA business permits. For potholes, garbage piles, or broken street lights, report to KCCA on 0414-254-460 or visit your division office.
answer.lg: Mu Kampala, KCCA ekola bino: enteekateeka y'ekibuga, okuzimba n'okuddaabiriza enguudo, okuyonja kasasiro, amatale n'ebifo eby'obusuubuzi, ne permit za KCCA. Ku binnya, kasasiro oba taala ezonoonese, tegeeza KCCA ku 0414-254-460 oba ogende ku offiisi ya divizoni yo.
answer.sw: Kampala, KCCA hushughulikia: mipango ya jiji, ujenzi na ukarabati wa barabara, ukusanyaji wa taka, masoko na maeneo ya biashara, na vibali vya biashara vya KCCA. Kwa mashimo, milundo ya taka, au taa za barabarani zilizoharibika, ripoti kwa KCCA kwa 0414-254-460 au tembelea ofisi ya divisheni yako.

illegal_practices.en: Nobody may charge you a private fee for KCCA garbage collection or road repair. Those are public services. Report impostors to KCCA or Police.
illegal_practices.lg: Tewali akkirizibwa kukusasuza ssente za kyama ku kuyonja kasasiro kwa KCCA oba okuddaabiriza enguudo. Ebyo biweereza bya gavumenti. Abafere bategeeze ku KCCA oba ku Poliisi.
illegal_practices.sw: Hakuna anayeruhusiwa kukutoza ada ya kibinafsi kwa ukusanyaji taka wa KCCA au ukarabati wa barabara. Hizo ni huduma za umma. Ripoti matapeli kwa KCCA au Polisi.

en: Note the exact location of the problem (road name, landmark)
Call KCCA on 0414-254-460 or visit your division office
Keep the reference number and follow up after 3 days
lg: Kubira KCCA ku 0414-254-460 oba ogende ku offiisi ya divizoni
Kwata namba yo era obuuzeeko nga wayiseewo nnaku 3
sw: Andika mahali kamili pa tatizo (jina la barabara, alama)
Pigia KCCA kwa 0414-254-460 au tembelea ofisi ya divisheni
Hifadhi namba ya kumbukumbu na ufuatilie baada ya siku 3

question.en: Did you know? Potholes and garbage piles in Kampala are KCCA's job, not LC1's.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Ebinnya ne kasasiro mu Kampala mulimu gwa KCCA, si gwa LC1.
question.sw: Ulijua? Mashimo na milundo ya taka Kampala ni kazi ya KCCA, si ya LC1.

answer.en: Yes. Call KCCA on 0414-254-460 with the exact location.
answer.lg: Yee. Kubira KCCA ku 0414-254-460 ng'olina ekifo kyennyini.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Pigia KCCA kwa 0414-254-460 ukiwa na mahali kamili.
